ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 ROKRAT C2 — non-browser process beaconing to Dropbox/pCloud/Yandex/Box cloud APIs
ucs.description: Hunts the signature ROKRAT (and successor implants) command-and-control pattern where ScarCruft uses legitimate cloud-storage REST APIs (api.dropboxapi.com, api.pcloud.com, cloud-api.yandex.net, api.box.com, cloud.mail.ru) for bidirectional C2 and exfiltration. Flagged when the requesting binary is a scripting host or unsigned LOLBin rather than the vendor's own sync client or a browser — APT37's defining post-exploitation behavior since 2017 across the InkySquid, Operation Daybreak, and CHM/LNK delivery campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS where DNS.query IN ("api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","dl.dropboxusercontent.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com","api.mediafire.com","cloud.mail.ru") by DNS.src DNS.query host | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` | join type=inner src [ | tstats summariesonly=true values(Processes.process_name) as proc_names values(Processes.process) as cmdlines from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","hh.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user | rename Processes.dest as src | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ] | search NOT proc_names IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","Dropbox.exe","OneDrive.exe","GoogleDriveFS.exe","YandexDisk.exe") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","dl.dropboxusercontent.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com","api.mediafire.com","cloud.mail.ru"]);
let SyncClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","Dropbox.exe","Box.exe","YandexDisk.exe","OneDrive.exe","googledrivesync.exe","GoogleDriveFS.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SyncClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), HitCount = count(),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteIP
| where HitCount >= 1   // ROKRAT beacons every 60s; one is enough — tune to >= N if noisy
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","dl.dropboxusercontent.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com","api.mediafire.com","cloud.mail.ru"]);
let SuspectHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","hh.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let DnsHits = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
    | project DnsTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, Name;
let ProcHits = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where tolower(ProcName) in (SuspectHosts)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcName, CommandLine, TargetUserName;
DnsHits
| join kind=inner ProcHits on Computer
| where ProcTime between ((DnsTime - 5m) .. (DnsTime + 5m))
| project DnsTime, Computer, ClientIP, Name, ProcName, CommandLine, TargetUserName
| order by DnsTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.dropboxapi.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR dl.dropboxusercontent.com OR api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR binapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.ru OR api.box.com OR upload.box.com OR api.mediafire.com OR cloud.mail.ru) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IEXPLORE.EXE OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\DROPBOX.EXE OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\ONEDRIVE.EXE OR *\GoogleDriveFS.exe OR *\Box.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.dropboxapi\.com|content\.dropboxapi\.com|dl\.dropboxusercontent\.com|api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|binapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.ru|api\.box\.com|upload\.box\.com|api\.mediafire\.com|cloud\.mail\.ru)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|opera|dropbox|box|yandexdisk|onedrive|googledrivesync|googledrivefs)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| _count > 0
ucs.rationale: Dropbox/pCloud/Yandex/Box REST APIs called from a scripting host or LOLBin (rather than the vendor's own sync client) is the canonical ROKRAT C2 fingerprint documented by Cisco Talos, ESET, Kaspersky and Volexity across InkySquid, Operation Daybreak, Erebus and the 2022–2024 Group123 spearphish campaigns. APT37 is one of only a handful of clusters that consistently abuse pCloud + Yandex Disk toget

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 ScarCruft CHM/LNK/HWP initial-access chain spawning scripted ROKRAT loader
ucs.description: Hunts ScarCruft's signature delivery sequence: a Korean-targeted lure (CHM Help file, weaponised LNK shortcut, or Hangul HWP/HWPX document) opens via hh.exe / explorer.exe / mshta.exe and chains to a scripting host (PowerShell, mshta, rundll32, wscript) whose command line references the cloud-storage staging URL the next-stage ROKRAT payload is hosted on. This is the exact in-memory loader pattern Talos, ESET, AhnLab and Mandiant attribute to Group123 / TEMP.Reaper from 2021 through 2025.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hh.exe","mshta.exe","explorer.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*.chm*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.hwp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.hwpx*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe") AND (Processes.process="*dropboxapi*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud.com*" OR Processes.process="*yandex.net*" OR Processes.process="*yandex.ru*" OR Processes.process="*box.com*" OR Processes.process="*mediafire*" OR Processes.process="*cloud.mail.ru*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*WebClient*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i).*\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LureParents = dynamic(["hh.exe","mshta.exe","explorer.exe","hwp.exe","hwordapp.exe","gbb.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let CloudIndicators = dynamic(["dropboxapi","pcloud.com","yandex.net","yandex.ru","box.com","mediafire","cloud.mail.ru"]);
let ScriptIndicators = dynamic(["DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String","WebClient","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","BitsAdmin"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LureParents)
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (".chm",".lnk",".hwp",".hwpx")
| where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudIndicators) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (ScriptIndicators)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LureParents = dynamic(["hh.exe","mshta.exe","explorer.exe","hwp.exe","hwordapp.exe","gbb.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let CloudIndicators = dynamic(["dropboxapi","pcloud.com","yandex.net","yandex.ru","box.com","mediafire","cloud.mail.ru"]);
let ScriptIndicators = dynamic(["DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String","WebClient","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","BitsAdmin"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1])
| where (tolower(ParentName) in (LureParents))
   or CommandLine has_any (".chm",".lnk",".hwp",".hwpx")
| where tolower(ChildName) in (ScriptHosts)
| where CommandLine has_any (CloudIndicators) or CommandLine has_any (ScriptIndicators)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, ParentName, ChildName, CommandLine, ProcessId, NewProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft CHM/LNK/HWP Loader Spawning Script Host With Cloud Stager
id: 9b3a5e51-2c47-4d2c-bf0a-3d7e2c1f8d2a
status: experimental
description: Detects APT37/ScarCruft (Group123, TEMP.Reaper, InkySquid) initial access where CHM (hh.exe), MSHTA, or Explorer launching a Hangul/HWP/LNK lure spawns a scripting host whose command line references known ROKRAT cloud staging endpoints (Dropbox/pCloud/Yandex/Box/Mediafire) or PowerShell remote-download primitives.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/rokrat-reloaded/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/05/09/scarcruft-asec-mavinject-rambleon-android/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_image:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\hh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hwordapp.exe'
      - '\gbb.exe'
  parent_cmd:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - '.chm'
      - '.lnk'
      - '.hwp'
      - '.hwpx'
  child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'dropboxapi'
      - 'pcloud.com'
      - 'yandex.net'
      - 'yandex.ru'
      - 'box.com'
      - 'mediafire'
      - 'cloud.mail.ru'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'WebClient'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
  condition: (parent_image or parent_cmd) and child_image and child_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Korean-language enterprise help workflows that legitimately wrap CHM with PowerShell downloaders (rare)
  - Internal red-team replicating APT37 tradecraft
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.001
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0067
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\hh.exe OR *\HH.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\Hwp.exe OR *\HWP.EXE OR *\Hwordapp.exe) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*.chm* OR *.CHM* OR *.lnk* OR *.LNK* OR *.hwp* OR *.HWP* OR *.hwpx*)) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe) @CommandLine:(*dropboxapi* OR *pcloud.com* OR *yandex.net* OR *yandex.ru* OR *box.com* OR *mediafire* OR *cloud.mail.ru* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *IEX* OR *FromBase64String* OR *WebClient* OR *EncodedCommand*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ParentBaseFileName=/^(hh|mshta|explorer|hwp|hwordapp|gbb)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)\\.(chm|lnk|hwp|hwpx)\\b", field=ParentBaseFileName))
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript|curl|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(dropboxapi|pcloud\\.com|yandex\\.(net|ru)|box\\.com|mediafire|cloud\\.mail\\.ru|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|IEX|FromBase64String|WebClient|-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: APT37's delivery toolkit has been remarkably consistent across the InkySquid (2021), Operation Daybreak, Konni-overlap, and 2024 Group123 campaigns: Hangul/CHM/LNK lure → hh.exe or mshta.exe → in-memory PowerShell/mshta stager → cloud-storage REST API pull of ROKRAT. Few other clusters chain CHM-via-hh.exe to pCloud/Yandex specifically (LazarusGroup uses Dropbox but rarely hh.exe; Kimsuky favors H
